description: This PHP source file defines the jjwg_Areas class, which extends jjwg_Areas_sugar, and includes methods for handling geographic polygons, centroids, areas, and point-in-polygon calculations within the SuiteCRM framework.

classes.name: jjwg_Areas
classes.description: A class representing geographic areas with polygon, centroid, and area calculations, extending jjwg_Areas_sugar.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object and loads configuration if $init is true.

methods.name: configuration
methods.description: Loads map configuration settings from global variables and initializes jjwg_Maps bean.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves the object by ID and defines polygon, area, and centroid.

methods.name: define_polygon
methods.description: Parses the coordinates string to define the polygon vertices.

methods.name: define_area_loc
methods.description: Defines the geographic location of the area based on centroid.

methods.name: define_centroid
methods.description: Calculates the centroid of the polygon.

methods.name: define_loc
methods.description: Defines marker location details, validating coordinates.

methods.name: is_valid_lng
methods.description: Checks if longitude is within valid range (-180 to 180).

methods.name: is_valid_lat
methods.description: Checks if latitude is within valid range (-90 to 90).

methods.name: is_marker_in_area
methods.description: Checks if a marker object is within the polygon area.

methods.name: is_point_in_area
methods.description: Checks if a longitude/latitude point is within the polygon.

methods.name: point_in_polygon
methods.description: Determines if a point is inside the polygon using ray casting algorithm.

methods.name: point_on_vertex
methods.description: Checks if a point coincides with any polygon vertex.

methods.name: point_string_to_coordinates
methods.description: Converts a coordinate string into an array with x and y.
